entities.summary: Luigi Chiarini was an Italian abbot, orientalist and translator, born near Montepulciano (Italy), April 26, 1789, died February 28, 1832, in Warsaw (Poland), known for the first translation of the Talmud in French. His translation of the Talmud benefited from a grant from Tsar Nicholas I.
